## Validation

List commands or scenarios run and actual results. Distinguish local, Ubuntu, GPU, and live carrier checks. Explicitly list checks not run and why.

## Risks and compatibility

Describe remaining limitations, public contract changes, migration needs, dependency/license changes, and operational impact where relevant.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Focused change with relevant tests and documentation
- [ ] No secrets, private recordings, or personal data in the diff/evidence
- [ ] Dependencies and generated files reproducible, where applicable
- [ ] No skipped or simulated test represented as a live pass
